title: Farm Friends Sounds
yt_description:
Join Pip and friends on the farm to learn animal sounds. This fun song teaches toddlers to recognize and imitate different farm animal sounds. Your little one will love singing along with Pip and Lulu.

🎵 Farm Friends Sounds

Hello friends
Let's go farm
See the animals

Cow says moo
Pig says oink
Sheep says baa

Farm friends make sounds
Fun on the farm
Sounds all around

Farm friends make sounds
Fun on the farm
Sounds all around

Bye friends now
Farm fun is done
See you soon

Bouncy Meadow — Kids Songs with Pip, Lulu & Bo
Animation and music created with AI tools, written and reviewed by a human.
